entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello? I... I need some help with an order, please.
You've reached VeloFit, this is David. I can certainly help you today. How are you doing?
Oh, hi David. I'm not doing great, to be honest. I'm just so disappointed. I ordered a jersey a while back and I... I need to return it.

I'm sorry to hear you're disappointed. I can definitely look into that for you. To start, can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?
It's the wrong size. I saved up for it, and I was so excited, but it's just too tight across the shoulders. I feel awful about it. I've been a loyal customer for years and this has never happened.
I understand, that's definitely frustrating when you're looking forward to something. Let me pull up your account. I see the order here, it looks like it was delivered 47 days ago. Is that correct?
Yes, that sounds right. I've been so busy, I kept meaning to call. I just... I really needed this money back for some other things coming up. I was hoping it wasn't too late.
Not at all. I've just checked our policy for you. That jersey is a standard item, and you are well within our 90-day return window. We can absolutely process a return for a full refund for you.
Oh, really? That's... that's a huge relief. Thank you.

Of course. We can also do an exchange for the correct size if you'd like. Since you're one of our VIP customers and had this trouble, I can offer complimentary expedited shipping on the new size to get it to you faster. How does that sound?
You can do that? An exchange would be wonderful, actually. I did really love the design. Wow, thank you, David. You've really turned my day around.

It's my pleasure. I'm happy we could find a solution for you. I'm sending the return label to your email now for the jersey that was too tight. Just send that back, and I'm processing the order for the new size right away. You should see it in 1-2 business days.
Perfect! Thank you so much for your help.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today for VeloFit?
No, that was everything. Thanks again!
Have a great day, and enjoy your new jersey when it arrives!
